children: Bruce Schanzer, through Erez Asset Management and affiliated funds, disclosed a 5.8% stake in Empire State Realty Trust, Inc. Class A shares. The Schedule 13D was filed on Oct. 05, 2026, following open-market purchases totaling about $43 million. The move signals that Schanzer sees the stock as undervalued and plans to engage on strategy and capital use.

Schanzer has begun talks with Empire State Realty Trust’s management and board on capital allocation, business operations, and strategy, including a possible "strategic review of some or all" assets. He also plans to speak with other shareholders and outside parties.

He aims to discuss governance, board composition, balance sheet choices, and payouts, noting interest in "dividend and/or buyback policies." He may buy more shares, sell shares, or hedge exposure as he evaluates the company’s direction and market conditions.

Bruce Schanzer is a U.S. real estate investor who serves as Chairman and Chief Investment Officer of Erez Asset Management. Erez Asset Management oversees funds focused on real estate securities, including Erez REIT Opportunities LP. Schanzer previously led Cedar Realty Trust, giving him a track record in public REIT strategy and portfolio actions.
